'''Malea Janarus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. She was the wife of [[Dorian Janarus]], who served as a [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and later as the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] until [[3640 BBY]].<ref name="Nathema" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Death_of_Malea_Janarus.jpg|thumb|left|Malea Janarus is sacrificed to Zildrog.]]
Malea Janarus appears during "The Nathema Conspiracy" flashpoint only if [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]] is a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty Hunter]] who killed the Supreme Chancellor Janarus or captured him for [[Darth Tormen]] towards the end of their class story. In this case, Malea will seek revenge on them and join the [[Order of Zildrog]] led by [[Vinn Atrius]], only to be sacrificed as fuel to awaken [[Zildrog]] by [[GEMINI 16]] on [[Nathema]]. If the player makes a light side choice to spare the Chancellor, [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Vindis]] will appear instead of Malea Janarus, while the other classes face antagonists from their own class stories.<ref name="Nathema" />
